environment: iOS 27 simulator in Device Hub, Hermes, Expo development build, React Compiler, React DevTools profiling
procedure: Baseline: select Green Bed in the furnished living room; drag from (307,833) to (322,838), release, capture successful autosave with an initially empty Undo stack.
Final: reload updated app; repeat the same selected-bed drag and successful autosave from the original layout.

Repeat: after the first successful save, move the bed using its Right accessibility action; verify autosave with existing Undo history. This is a repeated-save check, not a second continuous-drag sample.
Undo all test changes; verify Undo disabled and original layout restored. Temporary profiler wrappers removed and drag measurement disabled.
findings: Save validation and applying edits each stayed below 1 ms.
Baseline unnecessarily replaced both furniture arrays on bed movement, invalidating removal menus in all rooms.
Latest callback bridges keep stationary native targets cached, without using stale drop validation or removal lookups.

Collision resolver rebuilt stationary geometry indexes after each drop; an intermediate capture measured 33.649 ms in resolver creation. Per-room caches now reuse exact shape inputs and discard removed objects.
Undo history no longer replaces its controls for each added entry. On first save, only the edited room rerenders for availability.
limitations: These are development-build React render/commit measurements, not physical finger-to-display or production-device latency.
Only one paired baseline/final successful drag was captured; the repeated sample uses accessibility movement.

The maximum sampled JS animation-frame gap fell from about 571 ms to 279 ms; measurable gaps remain, including devtools/native work outside React render duration. This does not establish frame-perfect drop latency.
The world clock advanced naturally from daytime to nighttime between captures. Furniture layout and tested bed movement were restored between runs.

tests.roomEditing: passed, including reference preservation, cached/fresh collision parity and support invalidation
tests.nativeRoom: passed; harness updated for existing UI shared values, Filament shared-value sync and __DEV__
